title: GAP Waiver Addenda Voluntary Cancellation and the Signed Cancellation Request
content:
**Rule.** A borrower may cancel a GAP Waiver Addendum at any time while it is active. A voluntary cancellation is processed only under a cancellation request that the borrower has signed; every plan requires the signature.

**Signature period.** The request must be signed no later than the plan's request validity period after it was created; that period is 10 calendar days under every plan. The period is counted in calendar days from the date part of the moment the request was created, and a signature on the last day is in time. An unsigned request lapses.

**Effect.** The cancellation is effective on the date the signed request was received, and its refund is issued within the plan's voluntary processing period. A request signed within the plan's free-look period after the contract date receives the free-look refund. Cancelling the addendum never changes the contract's scheduled payment or term, and the refund is credited as principal.

**What the records must show.** The request and its signature are read from the cancellation request record for this addendum, not from the borrower's account of them. That record shows when the request was created and when it was signed.

### Boundary cases (abstract dates)

| Request created on | Signed on | Result |
|---|---|---|
| day D | the 10th calendar day after D | in time, because the last day counts |
| day D | the 11th calendar day after D | too late, and the request lapses |
| day D | not signed | the request lapses and no voluntary cancellation is processed |

Only the date part of the creation moment counts. A request created late in the evening of day D still starts its period from day D.
